title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.10: Renamed Living the Dream to Upside Down and Write it Down to Keep in Mind. New hidden power Living the Dream: holding both Bright Side and Stage Presence makes them Swap & Invert simultaneously each turn. Stage Presence now stacks (Swap N with N copies).
